build_MPD: build a Period Discriminator (MPD) module to analyze audio waveforms across specified sample periods
build_MSD: build a Scale Discriminator (MSD) module to analyze audio at different sampling rates using 1D convolutions
build_MRD: build a Multi-band Spectrogram Discriminator (MRD) module to analyze complex spectrograms across frequency bands
build_Discriminator: build a combined Discriminator module that runs MPD, MSD, and MRD discriminators on audio input
test_Discriminator_forward: test the Discriminator forward pass by passing a batch of audio tensors and inspecting feature map outputs
